events.title: MANEVA & FABIO BRAZZA + TÚLIO - Brazilian Day
events.description: SUNDAY 13th of September | Miami Marketta | Gold Coast For the first time as part of the Brazilian Day Experience, one of Brazil's most beloved bands, Maneva, brings their acclaimed live show to the Gold Coast for a special night celebrating Brazilian music, culture, and community. With a career spanning over two decades, MANEVA has become one of the biggest names in Brazilian reggae, captivating millions of fans through their uplifting melodies, powerful lyrics, and unforgettable live performances. Known for hits such as Lágrimas de Alegria, Luz Que Me Traz Paz, and O Destino Não Quis, the band has built a devoted following throughout Brazil and around the world, delivering a unique blend of reggae, rock, and Brazilian rhythms that continues to inspire audiences of all ages. Sharing the stage is renowned Brazilian rapper, poet, and songwriter FÁBIO BRAZZA, one of the most respected voices in contemporary Brazilian hip-hop. Celebrated for his intelligent lyricism, storytelling, and powerful social commentary, Fábio Brazza's performances combine energy, authenticity, and artistry in a way that resonates deeply with audiences. Opening the celebration is Gold Coast-based Brazilian artist TÚLIO, whose music reflects the vibrant spirit of modern Brazil while representing the strength and passion of Australia's Brazilian community. More than just a concert, Brazilian Day Experience is a celebration of everything that makes Brazil unique. Enjoy authentic Brazilian food, cultural experiences, art, community connections, and an atmosphere filled with the colours, flavours, rhythms, and energy that have made Brazilian culture famous worldwide. Whether you're Brazilian, have Brazilian roots, or simply love great music and cultural experiences, this is your opportunity to be part of an unforgettable event bringing the heart of Brazil to the Gold Coast. One day. Three incredible artists. One unforgettable Brazilian celebration. Presented by Tropical Lab and Folia's Entertainment.

events.title: LIFE DRAWING SESSIONS - SEPTEMBER 16
events.description: Join us for a curated evening of Life Drawing with Live Music in Studio 56 at the Miami Marketta. At Life Drawing Sessions our focus is not on the outcome of your drawing, rather it is about the process of giving into the act of creating with music and muse. This event embraces people of all drawing levels from novice to maestro.

events.title: MAGIK MARKETS - PRACTICAL MAGIC
events.description: Practical Magic Market ✨🍸 Come for the magik, stay for the margaritas. We’re spreading the magik once again at Miami Marketta with a market night inspired by the spellbinding world of Practical Magic . With the release of the classic witchy movie’s much-anticipated sequel, we’re leaning into all things magical, mystical and a little bit margarita. Join us Thursday 17 September from 5–9pm for an evening of street food, drinks, market stalls and plenty of witchy vibes. Gather your coven, grab your favourite people and settle in for a night of good food, good drinks and a little bit of movie magic. And, of course, no Practical Magic-inspired night would be complete without midnight margaritas . 🍸✨ So dust off your witchiest outfit, bring your crew and come make a little magik with us.

events.title: Forró No Marketta - September 17
events.description: Forró No Marketta - Free Monthly Dance Night Step into the rhythm of Brazil with Forró No Marketta, a free monthly night of music, dancing and good vibes. Kick things off with a free forró lesson at 6pm, then enjoy social dancing and a DJ set from 7pm. Forró is a lively and playful partner dance from the North of Brazil, perfect for beginners and seasoned dancers alike. With street food, great company and our signature Brazilian caipirinhas flowing, it’s the ultimate midweek escape. Join us every third Thursday of the month and experience something a little different.

events.title: Unsettled: The Search Between Wandering & Belonging
events.description: After multiple sold-out seasons across Australia and a 5-star review at Fringe World Perth , Unsettled: The Search Between Wandering & Belonging returns to the Gold Coast, for a special one-night performance. One woman. One suitcase. Too many existential crisis. What happens when home is no longer a place you can find on a map? Unsettled: The Search Between Wandering & Belonging is a fearless, funny, and deeply moving one-woman show about chasing dreams, getting lost along the way, and building a new life from scratch. With humour and intimate honesty, Agustina takes you on a wild ride through the heartbreak, comedy, and chaos of living abroad. Vulnerable, hilarious, and fiercely alive, Unsettled  invites you to feel seen, laugh, cry, and maybe even find a piece of yourself along the way. What began as a street performance in Port Douglas has evolved into a multi-city, sold-out show , touring Magnetic Island, Airlie Beach, Noosa, Byron Bay, Gold Coast, Margaret River, and successful sell out seasons at Adelaide Fringe, Fringe World Perth, Sydney Fringe & Melbourne Fringe. Following a successful Byron Bay season, with nine performances and multiple sold-out nights, Unsettled heads just up the coast to Gold Coast. After previously appearing at Miami Marketta as part of HOLA Marketta the  Winter Latin Festival , the show returns for a special standalone performance, bringing its playful storytelling to new audiences. This time, experience it in a cozy, intimate venue, perfect for getting up close and personal with the story. ⚠️Limited capacity. One night only. Don’t miss out 😏 ⏰ Doors open 6PM     Show 7PM - 9PM 📌 Miami Marketta, Mona Lisa's Lair More than just a show! Enjoy  live music before the performance , grab a drink and settle in for the evening. Following the show, there will be a  Q&A and informal discussion with Agustina , exploring and unpacking some of the themes at the heart of  Unsettled . Come for the story. Stay for the conversation

events.title: CHUTNEY
events.description: "Beloved Gold Coast five-piece Chutney are dusting off their instruments and returning to the stage for a massive night of indie rock at Miami Marketta on Saturday, September 19th. events.title: THE OPEN FONDA

events.title: Strung Out (USA)
events.description: US punk-metal mainstays Strung Out return to Australia this September to celebrate 30 years of their landmark album Suburban Teenage Wasteland Blues with a national run of headline shows. Originally released in 1996, Suburban Teenage Wasteland Blues crammed 13 songs into 32 breakneck minutes and became a defining record for a generation of punk fans. From the opening blast of “Firecracker” through to “Wrong Side of the Tracks”, the album’s mix of hook-heavy melodies and high-speed riffs still hits just as hard today. Across ten albums and countless tours, Strung Out have built a reputation as one of the most explosive live bands in punk rock – loud, tight and direct, with no throwbacks for the sake of it and no wasted moments.   This September, Australian fans will hear Suburban Teenage Wasteland Blues celebrated throughout the set, alongside favourites from across the band’s catalogue.

events.title: Roaring Lion (Bob Marley Tribute)
events.description: Get ready for a proper Bob Marley celebration with Roaring Lion, Queensland’s powerhouse 8-piece tribute band bringing the sounds of "The Legend" to life. Expect all the classics - Exodus, Could You Be Loved, Buffalo Soldier, Three Little Birds, One Love - the kind of set that gets everyone singing, moving, and locked in from the first song. Grab your crew and vibe it out. Whether you’re a longtime Marley fan or just want a solid night with good music and good energy, this one hits right. Roaring Lion is Australia’s premiere Bob Marley tribute band. On stage, its eight band members present a colourful explosion of the best reggae of our times - the beautiful and enduring music of Bob Marley. Formed in 2019, Roaring Lion is based in Queensland and has been performing regularly throughout Queensland. Roaring Lion have also performed in New South Wales and Melbourne, Victoria. Everywhere they play, their audiences sing and dance, in happy celebration of the man and his message. The musicians in Roaring Lion work hard to represent Bob Marley’s music with respect and authenticity. The music is classic roots reggae with drum ‘n’ bass, bubble, skank, lead and rhythm guitars. Backing vocalists sing harmonies on every song, while keys play the familiar sounds of clavinet, Moog, and Hammond organ, plus horns and strings. In 2024, Roaring Lion had the honour to open the Queensland premiere for the ‘Bob Marley: One Love’ movie by Paramount Pictures. The band consistently presents a tight show of the most popular songs, as well as other well-known and cherished melodies. Roaring Lion continues to grow its repertoire of over sixty songs to keep shows fresh and deepen engagement with its loyal followers. Roaring Lion delivers a show for all to remember, and is consistently invited back to perform at venues.
